outdated_panel_broadcasts.title: Elk-M1 Global Programming broadcasts unconfirmed
outdated_panel_broadcasts.description:
Home Assistant has not yet seen a broadcast from these Global Programming settings, which push zone/output/task/light/keypad changes and the event log without polling: {settings}.

This may just mean nothing of that type has changed yet, or it may mean the setting needs to be enabled on the panel (via keypad or ElkRP, under Global Programming, locations 35-40). If it stays unconfirmed after triggering the relevant activity (e.g. opening a door), enable the setting on the panel and reload this integration.

deprecated_sensor.description:
The sensor {entity_name} (`{entity_id}`) is deprecated because it has been replaced with `{replacement_entity_id}`.

Update your dashboards, templates, automations and scripts to use the replacement entity, then disable the deprecated sensor to have it removed after the next restart.
deprecated_sensor.title: Deprecated sensor detected

deprecated_sensor_scripts.description:
The sensor {entity_name} (`{entity_id}`) is deprecated because it has been replaced with `{replacement_entity_id}`.

The sensor was used in the following automations or scripts:
{items}

Update the above automations or scripts to use the replacement entity, then disable the deprecated sensor to have it removed after the next restart.
deprecated_sensor_scripts.title: [%key:component::elkm1::issues::deprecated_sensor::title%]

programming_unattributed.title: Elk-M1 remote programming session with no announced source
programming_unattributed.description: The panel reported a remote programming session starting at {started} that no tool announced through elkm1.programming_session_start. If this was ElkRP or another tool you ran yourself, no action is needed; otherwise review who has the RP access code. The issue clears when a tool claims the running session; otherwise dismiss it once you have reviewed it.

programming_claim_unmatched.title: Elk-M1 programming session announced but never seen
programming_claim_unmatched.description: {source} announced a programming session at {claimed_at}, but the panel has not reported a remote programming session since and the integration is still connected. The tool may have failed to open its session, or it may have run while this integration was disabled. It clears when the tool reports the session ended.

beep.description: Whether to beep when the message is displayed. Live-tested and not confirmed: the panel accepted this flag with no error either way, but no audible beep occurred on the tested keypad regardless of this setting.
beep.name: Beep

clear.description: 0=clear message, 1=clear message with * key, 2=Display until timeout, per the manual. Live-tested against a real panel: 0 and 2 both showed nothing on the keypad; only 1 actually displayed the message, folded into the keypad's existing rotating status line rather than a fixed line1/line2 position. Defaults to 1 for that reason.
